notes:
The spec says the leading spaces of the literal text starting each line are analyzed and that the minimum is removed from every such line, without mentioning blank lines. hashicorp/hcl skips lines that contain only whitespace, both when finding the minimum and when removing it (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go). Removing the minimum from that line too would give "a
    
b
".
